title: Deuteronomy 8: Keep the Commandments and Live
body:
Read the chapter → [Deuteronomy 8](/bible/deuteronomy/8)

**[Deuteronomy 8:1](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v1)</sup> All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.

- All the commandments shall ye observe to do, that ye may live and multiply and go in and possess the land. The commandments are life; everything else brings death to us.
- This is why you must vacate and run from Christianity as fast as possible, not ease out over years of so-called research. Once you know the man-made religions teach no commandments while our people die by the thousands, you should run to this truth and start keeping the commandments, because this is your life.

  Precepts:
  - **[Proverbs 7:2](/bible/proverbs/7#v2)**
    > <sup>[2](/bible/proverbs/7#v2)</sup> Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

    Keep my commandments and live, and my law as the apple of thine eye; it has been the same since the days of old, and the commandments ultimately lead to eternal life.

**[Deuteronomy 8:2-3](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v2)**

> <sup>[2](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v2)</sup> And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v3)</sup> And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.

- Remember all the way which the Lord led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee and to prove thee, to know whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or no. Trials and tribulations in this flesh are the Most High proving us the same way, whether a lost spouse, family separating from you, a lost job, or strife with friends.
- He fed thee with manna to make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord. Christ quoted this very verse walking in the earth; he was pulling from the old covenant, which proves nothing has been done away with, for he would not quote something that was abolished.
- Far too many tuck and run when the Most High is proving them; he never gives us something we are not able to overcome, and through Israel's schools, classes, and daily teaching he is giving you the way to bear the temptation. Prove to him that you will endure it, love him, and persevere; hard times are the perfect segue back into the vomit you came out of if you do not stand.

  Precepts:
  - **[1 Corinthians 10:13](/bible/1-corinthians/10#v13)**
    > <sup>[13](/bible/1-corinthians/10#v13)</sup> There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

    There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man; God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able, but will with the temptation also make a way to escape.

**[Deuteronomy 8:4-5](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v4)**

> <sup>[4](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v4)</sup> Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v5)</sup> Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.

- Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
- As a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee: you do wrong, you get punished, exactly as a father raises his children. Who is more experienced than the Most High, the Ancient of days? There is no way we can tell him through our actions that we know what is right for us.
- This is why Esau has no judgment on him like Israel has: they are not the sons, so the Most High is not chastening them. You cannot do what the other nations do; when we get that in our heads we will be in a far better situation as a people.

  Precepts:
  - **[Hebrews 12:6-8](/bible/hebrews/12#v6)**
    > <sup>[6](/bible/hebrews/12#v6)</sup> For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
    >
    > <sup>[7](/bible/hebrews/12#v7)</sup> If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
    >
    > <sup>[8](/bible/hebrews/12#v8)</sup> But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

    Whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth; if ye be without chastisement, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
  - **[Hebrews 12:11](/bible/hebrews/12#v11)**
    > <sup>[11](/bible/hebrews/12#v11)</sup> Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

    No chastening for the present seemeth joyous, but grievous; nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

**[Deuteronomy 8:6-9](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v6)**

> <sup>[6](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v6)</sup> Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v7)</sup> For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v8)</sup> A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v9)</sup> A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

- Verses 7 through 9 are the precept for describing the land of milk and honey: a good land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths, of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates, a land of oil olive and honey, where thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, whose stones are iron and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass. Write it down and use it.
- Right now the land is not flowing with milk and honey: the place is desolate, full of desert places, and much of its food is imported, exactly as the prophecy requires until the Most High restores it.
- The Most High says he will return the land to its original form, like the garden of Eden; that is a precept in itself, for the garden of Eden is Jerusalem, the land of Israel, the land of milk and honey.

  Precepts:
  - **[Ezekiel 36:29-36](/bible/ezekiel/36#v29)**
    > <sup>[29](/bible/ezekiel/36#v29)</sup> I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
    >
    > <sup>[30](/bible/ezekiel/36#v30)</sup> And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
    >
    > <sup>[31](/bible/ezekiel/36#v31)</sup> Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
    >
    > <sup>[32](/bible/ezekiel/36#v32)</sup> Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
    >
    > <sup>[33](/bible/ezekiel/36#v33)</sup> Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
    >
    > <sup>[34](/bible/ezekiel/36#v34)</sup> And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
    >
    > <sup>[35](/bible/ezekiel/36#v35)</sup> And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
    >
    > <sup>[36](/bible/ezekiel/36#v36)</sup> Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.

    The desolate land shall be tilled and become like the garden of Eden, and when Israel learns the law they shall lothe themselves in their own sight for their iniquities; I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.

**[Deuteronomy 8:10-14](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v10)</sup> When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
>
> <sup>[11](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v11)</sup> Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v12)</sup> Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v13)</sup> And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v14)</sup> Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

- When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
- Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments: keeping the commandments is how you remember the Most High, and not keeping them is how you forget him. No wonder our families do not know God; forget the laws and you have forgotten him, for they go hand in hand.
- Consider how the doctrine of Christianity works: an entire book, especially the old covenant, says keep the commandments over and over, Christ himself says keep the commandments, and Christianity says read only the letters of Paul and do away with the commandments. That is strong witchcraft, to make you disbelieve what the very book says; it is Satan's playground.
- Lest when thy herds and thy silver and thy gold multiply, thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the house of bondage.

**[Deuteronomy 8:15-16](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v15)**

> <sup>[15](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v15)</sup> Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v16)</sup> Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

- He led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents and scorpions and drought, brought thee water out of the rock of flint, and fed thee with manna, to humble thee and to prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end.

  Precepts:
  - **[Numbers 21:6](/bible/numbers/21#v6)**
    > <sup>[6](/bible/numbers/21#v6)</sup> And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

    The fiery serpents of the wilderness: the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and much people of Israel died.

**[Deuteronomy 8:17-18](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v17)</sup> And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v18)</sup> But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

- Here is Christianity wrapped up in a few scriptures: and thou say in thine heart, my power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth. They keep no commandments and then boast, look what we have done, look at this job, look at all this stuff, as if the Most High gave them that power.
- But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant. The power to get wealth belongs to the covenant; if you forget God and keep no commandments, it was not God blessing you.
- Who blesses everybody that does not keep the commandments and still gets everything they desire? Satan says come as you are; whoever wants power, fame, and money in this world without obeying God can have it from him, and you will pay the piper when you meet Christ. Share these precepts with your family.

  Precepts:
  - **[Luke 4:5-7](/bible/luke/4#v5)**
    > <sup>[5](/bible/luke/4#v5)</sup> And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
    >
    > <sup>[6](/bible/luke/4#v6)</sup> And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
    >
    > <sup>[7](/bible/luke/4#v7)</sup> If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

    The devil shewed Christ all the kingdoms of the world and said, All this power will I give thee, for that is delivered unto me, and to whomsoever I will I give it: if thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
  - **[Jeremiah 13:11](/bible/jeremiah/13#v11)**
    > <sup>[11](/bible/jeremiah/13#v11)</sup> For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

    As the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear; our very life cleaves to the Most High, yet the people followed the religions instead.

**[Deuteronomy 8:19-20](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v19)**

> <sup>[19](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v19)</sup> And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/deuteronomy/8#v20)</sup> As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.

- If thou do at all forget the Lord thy God and walk after other gods, the religions, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
- Now you know why our people die, why the tribes were conquered and scattered: as the nations which the Lord destroyed before your face, so shall ye perish, because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God. We want thou shalt not, and we will not do thou shalt, therefore we perish.
